svg.text: KoFI subscriptions · our class wall, completed to phase 4 (policies and contact points)
Built from the stickies of the class session; names adjusted to the course model.
One database transaction: check stock, charge the saved card,
save the paid order, mark the delivery ready and schedule the next one
(planned date + interval). Missing stock: the reservation is rejected, nothing
is saved, the delivery stays due. The card charge is outside the database:
Until the customer decides, the delivery stays due and the daily run
retries it; an incomplete order is never sent. After removal the delivery
is still due: the next run places an order with the rest.
Delivered is the order's fact, not the delivery's:
the delivery ends when its order is placed.
KoFI today tracks orders only up to Shipped.
"(already in KoFI)": contact point with existing code
